subject: Evaluation & acceptance decision playbook — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@finrise.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@finrise.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation & acceptance decision playbook — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion I wanted to lay out a concise playbook for the security/compliance checkpoints that are gating your MAP acceptance and the proposed close timeline so your legal/procurement teams can line up reviews. High-level items: 

- SOC 2: We will provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (control period 2026). You can expect the report + bridge letter attached.
- SIG / CAIQ: We can prefill a CAIQ draft for you and serve as a point of contact for follow-up evidence. Typical turnaround for a first pass is ~5-8 business days depending on how many clarifications are needed.
- DPA: Draft attached (v2). Key negotiable items we expect: retention windows, subprocessors list, and export controls.
- Data retention (hosted API): default inbound/outbound content retention = 30 days for hosted customers; customer-managed retention up to 7 years available for Private deployments. Audit logs retained 13 months by default; operational logs (metrics/telemetry) 90 days.

Suggested decision timeline (so we can meet your target onboarding window):
- Jul 7: FinRise legal confirms primary retention preference and any non-standard DPA asks
- Jul 14: Redwood delivers SOC2, CAIQ prefill, and updated DPA reflecting your redlines
- Jul 22: Final decision / signature to lock MAP close and schedule onboarding

If your procurement timeline is shorter, tell us which date we should target and we'll prioritize. Also flagging that if you select the private deployment retention option, we will need a short technical call to confirm infrastructure and KMS requirements.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf (attestation), DPA-Redwood-FinRise-draft-v2.docx, CAIQ-prefill-FinRise.xlsx

Next steps: please confirm (1) preferred retention window, (2) who on your side will own the SIG questionnaire, and (3) target close date.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@finrise.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finrise.com, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@finrise.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & acceptance decision playbook — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Thanks Naomi — very clear. A couple quick clarifications from Legal/Procurement before we circulate internally: 

1) SOC 2 scope: can you confirm whether the report covers the hosted API control plane + data plane and any third-party CDNs/subprocessors that handle in-transit logs? Procurement wants explicit list of subprocessors and whether any are outside the US.
2) SIG/CAIQ: good to hear you can prefill. Can you estimate a tighter completion window if we commit to providing two SME contacts on our side (security and product)?
3) Retention: procurement typically tries to avoid >3 years unless justified. Can Redwood propose a compliance-friendly middle ground and a mechanism for certified deletion? We need language for automated deletion and confirmation for audit purposes.
4) Close date: our internal legal review will run Jul 8–15. If Redwood can provide SOC2 and the CAIQ prefill by Jul 9, we should be on track for a Jul 20–23 signature window.

Appreciate the attachments — procurement will attach them to the PR/PO.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@finrise.com>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@finrise.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & acceptance decision playbook — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Tom — thanks for the thoughtful list. Answers inline and action items below.

1) SOC 2 scope: The attached SOC 2 Type II (control period 2026) covers Redwood's hosted control plane, data plane, and the primary cloud provider instances used for inference. Subprocessors are listed in the attachments (third tab); the current set includes a US-based CDN and a global analytics vendor (both named in the report). If you need an addendum listing region-by-region subprocessors, we can produce that.

2) SIG/CAIQ timeline: If FinRise provides two SMEs within 24 hours of our request, we can turn around a completed CAIQ prefill + evidence pointers in 3 business days. Priyom will be your point person on Redwood's side to drive the questionnaire.

3) Retention / certified deletion: We support a few standard profiles for hosted customers: 30 days (default), 365 days (mid), and customer-archived up to 7 years (requires Private or a contractual addendum). For audit-grade deletion we provide an erase API plus a signed deletion confirmation for records removed via the erase API. For logs/telemetry: 90 days standard, 13 months for audit logs on request. We'll add the deletion confirmation language to the DPA if you want it codified.

4) Subprocessors / export: we will include an explicit subprocessors table in the updated DPA; none of the current subprocessors process data outside the jurisdictions we've discussed, but we will mark locations in the appendix for clarity.

Attachments sent with this email: SOC2-TypeII-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf, DPA-Redwood-FinRise-draft-v2.docx (redline-ready), CAIQ-prefill-FinRise.xlsx.

Action items: 
- FinRise: confirm which retention profile you prefer (30 / 365 / private-up-to-7yrs) and provide SME contact names for SIG.
- Redwood: Priyom will send the CAIQ prefill and the DPA with deletion confirmation language by EOD Jul 9.

If Jul 20–23 is your preferred signature window we'll prioritize the DPA turnaround. If you prefer earlier, please escalate and we will open a faster lane.

Best regards,
Naomi
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
